text:
marta: Brainstorm: a "mini comparator pill" that sits above the heatmap for quick p95 + throughput comparisons. Lightweight, keyboard-first, no panel switch. Mock: https://files.redwood/mini-pill-v1.png

sam: Nice! On hover does it highlight the same window on the heatmap?

marta: Yes 1 hover highlights heatmap area; click pins. Single-click to pin, double-click to clear.

jin: How do we show sampling? Badge `1/50`? tooltip expands to `Sample rate: 1 in 50 requests` + quick toggle to pause sampling.

lee: Accessibility: avoid color-only cues for overlap. Use diagonal hatch for compare, cross-hatch for overlap. Focus outline must be high-contrast and visible at 200% zoom. Keyboard: tab into pill, arrows move between elements, enter pins, space opens sample popover, esc clears. Add `aria-roledescription="compact range comparator"`.

ravi: Copy nit: microcopy under pill: change "Pin ranges to compare p95 & throughput" to "Pin ranges to compare p95 and throughput." avoid ampersand for screen readers.

sam: Implementation: ranges as `<button aria-pressed>` so screen readers get state. Avoid `role=slider`. Use CSS gradients for hatch textures to reduce SVG perf cost.

jin: Overlaps: when overlap > 5% show a tiny tooltip: "Overlap 1 combined weighted stats" and a `Merge` action to compute combined p95. Analytics: event `ui.mini_pill.interact` with action/base/compare/sample_rate/overlap_pct.

marta: UX tweak: show micro sparklines for p95 and throughput inside the pill (left/right) so folks get a glance. Tooltip contains p50/p95/throughput numbers.

lee: A11y test plan: NVDA+Chrome, VoiceOver+Safari, keyboard-only pass. Ensure `aria-live` announces pinned stats. For pattern fallback at small widths, remove hatches and rely on thicker outlines + labels (B / C).

sam: Dev tasks: debounce hover sync to avoid flicker, persist per-user in localStorage, write e2e for narrow-screen collapse. CI note: failing `heatmap-sync.test` earlier, I'll take it.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch `mini/comparator-pill` 1 CI: 3/4 passed, failing: `heatmap-sync.test`

marta: Action list: sam fix hover debounce + tests, jin add analytics + merge action unit test, lee run a11y smoke on prototype, ravi polish microcopy, I'll update mock and upload focused screenshot for docs PR.

ravi: Can you include a screenshot with keyboard focus visible? helps docs and QA.

marta: Will post tomorrow AM :sparkles:
